description: This file provides SwiftUI view components and supporting classes for previewing session messages in a macOS application, including caching, rate limiting, and network request handling for session preview data.

classes.name: SessionPreviewCache
classes.description: Actor managing an in-memory cache for session preview snapshots, supporting retrieval and storage.

classes.name: SessionPreviewLimiter
classes.description: Actor implementing rate limiting for concurrent session preview network requests.

methods.name: prewarm
methods.description: Preloads session previews for given session keys.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a session preview snapshot for a specific session key, using cache if available.
